moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, officially begins on August 7th, with previews often starting in late July, bringing thousands of shows to the Scottish capital.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Edinburgh's about to get its annual dose of artistic chaos! The Fringe officially kicks off on August 7th, but the buzz is already building. What show are you desperate to see?

angles.name: UK-wide appeal
angles.copy: From comedy to theatre, music to spoken word, the Edinburgh Fringe is just around the corner, transforming the city into a global stage. Who's heading north for it?

moments.title: Camp Bestival Dorset Returns
moments.blurb: The family-friendly Camp Bestival Dorset takes over Lulworth Castle from July 30th to August 2nd, featuring a diverse lineup of music and entertainment.

angles.name: Family Fun
angles.copy: Lulworth Castle is gearing up for Camp Bestival Dorset! The ultimate family festival kicks off July 30th. Who's packed their glitter and wellies?

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Four days of music, magic, and mayhem! Camp Bestival Dorset starts Wednesday. Get ready for some serious summer vibes.

moments.title: Good Vibrations Society Festival
moments.blurb: The Good Vibrations Society Festival runs from July 31st to August 2nd, offering a blend of music, wellness, and culture in the Sussex countryside.

angles.name: Mindful Festival
angles.copy: Good Vibrations Society Festival is almost here! Starting July 31st, it's three days of good vibes, great music, and wellness in Sussex. Who's in?

angles.name: Local Festival
angles.copy: Escape to the Sussex countryside next weekend for the Good Vibrations Society Festival. Perfect for recharging with top tunes and chill-out zones.

moments.title: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival
moments.blurb: Scotland's Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival takes place from July 30th to August 1st, known for its eclectic line-up and family-friendly atmosphere.

angles.name: Scottish Festival
angles.copy: Get ready for the Tartan Heart! Belladrum Festival kicks off July 30th for three days of incredible music and Highland fun. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Music & Culture
angles.copy: From the Highlands to your ears! Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival is just days away. Expect good music, good company, and maybe a bit of ceilidh dancing!

moments.title: Mick Jagger Turns 83
moments.blurb: The legendary frontman of The Rolling Stones, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday on July 26th.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Still got the moves like Jagger! The one and only Mick Jagger turns 83 tomorrow. What's your favourite Stones track?

angles.name: Timeless Performer
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Mick Jagger! Celebrating the enduring legacy of The Rolling Stones' electrifying frontman. Paint it Black or Jumpin' Jack Flash?

moments.title: Roger Taylor Turns 77
moments.blurb: Queen's iconic drummer, Roger Taylor, celebrates his 77th birthday on July 26th.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: A huge happy 77th birthday to Queen's drumming powerhouse, Roger Taylor, tomorrow! From 'Radio Ga Ga' to 'A Kind of Magic', his beats are legendary.

angles.name: Queen's Beat
angles.copy: Raising a stick to Roger Taylor of Queen, who turns 77 tomorrow! Celebrate with us by cranking up your favourite Queen anthem.

moments.title: Darlene Love Turns 85
moments.blurb: The legendary American singer and actress, Darlene Love, known for her powerful vocals and hits like 'Christmas (Baby Please Come Home)', celebrates her 85th birthday on July 26th.

angles.name: Soulful Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 85th birthday to the incredible Darlene Love tomorrow! A voice that truly defines soul and pop. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: The one and only Darlene Love celebrates her 85th birthday tomorrow! Her voice has graced countless classics. Let's celebrate a true music legend.

moments.title: Geddy Lee Turns 73
moments.blurb: Rush frontman and bassist Geddy Lee celebrates his 73rd birthday on July 29th.

angles.name: Prog Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 73rd birthday to the one and only Geddy Lee of Rush on Monday! An absolute icon of progressive rock bass and vocals.

angles.name: Rush Hour
angles.copy: Celebrating Geddy Lee's 73rd birthday on Monday! The voice and bass behind so many Rush masterpieces. What's your go-to Rush track?

moments.title: Patti Scialfa Turns 73
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter and E Street Band member Patti Scialfa, wife of Bruce Springsteen, celebrates her 73rd birthday on July 29th.

angles.name: E Street Star
angles.copy: Happy 73rd birthday to the brilliant Patti Scialfa on Monday! A vital part of the E Street Band and a phenomenal artist in her own right.

angles.name: Musical Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a wonderful 73rd birthday to Patti Scialfa this Monday! Her contributions to music are undeniable. Send her some love!

moments.title: Martina McBride Turns 60
moments.blurb: Award-winning American country music singer Martina McBride celebrates her 60th birthday on July 29th.

angles.name: Country Icon
angles.copy: Happy 60th birthday to the incredible Martina McBride on Monday! A true legend of country music with a voice that soars.

angles.name: Powerhouse Vocalist
angles.copy: Celebrating Martina McBride's 60th birthday this Monday! Her powerful ballads have touched millions. What's your favourite Martina track?

moments.title: Fatboy Slim Turns 63
moments.blurb: Influential British DJ and producer Fatboy Slim, real name Norman Cook, celebrates his 63rd birthday on July 31st.

angles.name: Dance Legend
angles.copy: Right here, right now! Happy 63rd birthday to the one and only Fatboy Slim on Wednesday! Still bringing the funk after all these years.

angles.name: Big Beat Boss
angles.copy: Norman Cook, aka Fatboy Slim, turns 63 on Wednesday! From The Housemartins to global dance icon, what a career. What's your favourite Big Beat anthem?

moments.title: Will Champion Turns 48
moments.blurb: Coldplay's drummer, Will Champion, celebrates his 48th birthday on July 31st.

angles.name: Coldplay's Beat
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to Coldplay's Will Champion, who turns 48 on Wednesday! The steady beat behind so many anthems.

angles.name: Drummer Love
angles.copy: Happy 48th birthday to Coldplay's Will Champion this Wednesday! From stadiums to speakers, his drumming drives the biggest band in the world.

moments.title: Joe Elliott Turns 67
moments.blurb: Def Leppard frontman Joe Elliott celebrates his 67th birthday on August 1st.

angles.name: Rock Voice
angles.copy: Pour some sugar on him! Def Leppard's legendary singer Joe Elliott turns 67 on Thursday. What's your favourite power ballad?

angles.name: Hair Metal Hero
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to Def Leppard's Joe Elliott this Thursday! Rock of Ages and beyond, a true 80s icon.

moments.title: Chuck D Turns 66
moments.blurb: Public Enemy co-founder and hip hop icon Chuck D celebrates his 66th birthday on August 1st.

angles.name: Hip Hop Legend
angles.copy: Don't believe the hype, but do believe it's Chuck D's 66th birthday on Thursday! Celebrating the Public Enemy icon.

angles.name: Influential Voice
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the incredibly influential Chuck D this Thursday! A pioneer whose words shaped a generation. What's your top Public Enemy track?

moments.title: Robert Cray Turns 73
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American blues guitarist and singer Robert Cray celebrates his 73rd birthday on August 1st.

angles.name: Blues Master
angles.copy: A very happy 73rd birthday to the phenomenal bluesman Robert Cray on Thursday! His guitar work is simply legendary.

angles.name: Smooth Blues
angles.copy: Celebrating the smooth sounds of Robert Cray, who turns 73 this Thursday! Get lost in his soulful blues on Nation Easy.

moments.title: Adam Duritz Turns 62
moments.blurb: Counting Crows frontman Adam Duritz celebrates his 62nd birthday on August 1st.

angles.name: Counting Crows Star
angles.copy: Happy 62nd birthday to the distinctive voice of Counting Crows, Adam Duritz, on Thursday! Those dreads and those lyrics are iconic.

angles.name: Alt Rock Voice
angles.copy: It's Adam Duritz's 62nd birthday this Thursday! The frontman who gave us 'Mr. Jones' and so many other 90s anthems. What's your favourite?

moments.title: Ian Broudie Turns 68
moments.blurb: The Lightning Seeds frontman Ian Broudie celebrates his 68th birthday on August 4th.

angles.name: Indie Pop Master
angles.copy: Three Lions, but only one Ian Broudie! The Lightning Seeds legend turns 68 on Sunday. What's your top track from him?

angles.name: Football's Anthem
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds on Sunday! The man behind one of the greatest football anthems ever. It's coming home!

moments.title: Paul Reynolds Turns 64
moments.blurb: Paul Reynolds, lead guitarist for the iconic 80s new wave band A Flock of Seagulls, celebrates his 64th birthday on August 4th.

angles.name: 80s Guitar Hero
angles.copy: If you wanna get away... celebrate Paul Reynolds' 64th birthday this Sunday! The guitar wizard from A Flock of Seagulls. What's your favourite 80s hit from them?

angles.name: New Wave Vibes
angles.copy: Happy 64th birthday to Paul Reynolds of A Flock of Seagulls on Sunday! Bringing those iconic new wave guitar riffs to life. Time to blast 'I Ran'!

moments.title: UK Summer Holidays in Full Swing
moments.blurb: Many schools across the UK are now fully into their summer holidays, with families enjoying breaks and staycations.

angles.name: Holiday Fun
angles.copy: It's officially peak summer holidays for many across the UK! Whether you're at home or away, hope you're making the most of it. What's your favourite summer activity?

angles.name: Local Staycation
angles.copy: Devon's looking glorious as the summer holidays continue! Perfect for staycations and days out. Where are you exploring in the county?

angles.name: Welsh Summer
angles.copy: School's out for summer! Our beautiful Welsh coastline and countryside are buzzing with families enjoying the holidays. What are your plans in Wales?
